svg.title: What it knows. 47 documents: 8 each for the Large Cap, Flexi Cap and Midcap funds, 9 for the ELSS Tax Saver Fund, and 14 general explainers. All four schemes sit at Very High on the SEBI riskometer, whose six levels run from Low to Very High. Large Cap Fund: benchmark NIFTY 100 TRI, SIP from Rs. 99, exit load 1% within 365 days. Flexi Cap Fund: benchmark Nifty 500 TRI, SIP from Rs. 99, exit load 1% within 365 days. ELSS Tax Saver Fund: benchmark NIFTY 500 TRI (tier 1) and Nifty 200 TRI (tier 2), from Rs. 99, 3 year lock in. Midcap Fund: benchmark NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI, SIP from Rs. 99, exit load per the scheme documents. General topics: SIP, NAV, ELSS, expense ratio, exit load, riskometer, SWP, STP, KYC, direct versus regular plans, equity taxation, statements, ELSS lock in, coverage. Figures are point in time, as of June 2025.

div.h2: Four schemes, read from the factsheet

div.p: Six SEBI levels from Low to Very High. Every scheme FundBot covers is an equity fund labelled Very High.
Docs per fund: Large Cap 8, Flexi Cap 8, ELSS 9, Midcap 8, general 14. Figures are point in time, as of June 2025.
